title: Irish route/operator/service calendar
reason: User problem/schema: trip_id, stop_id and departure_date scoped to the same publisher/feed; business sites need a coordinate bridge. Proposed joins: observed native agency/routes/trips/calendar/stops/stop_times references; public POWER weather context after time and coordinate choices. Demo InvoiceDate/BillingCity weather proposals provide potential calendar reuse. The sampled 2026–27 feed lacks coverage of the observed Chinook Invoice.InvoiceDate period, 2021-01-01 through 2025-12-22 (evidence/demo-demand.json). Answerable questions: which trips operate on a weekday or effective date; which stops belong to a route/operator; where is a historical feed needed? Visualizations: route map, stop sequence, service calendar and separate weather context. Gaps/cost/risks: NTA terms conflict blocks commercial/publication decisions; agency timezone is literally Europe/London; multiple feed duplication, GTFS times beyond 24:00, exceptions and shape units require review.
